description: Agent templates (reusable configurations). Instances are spawned by Orchestrator with unique instance_id. writes_state MUST be false for all worker templates; Orchestrator main session owns state writes.

templates.notes: Main Grok session in Cursor. Human + Grok jointly act as Orchestrator. Use /gloam-resume skill. Does not appear as a delegated worker in handoffs.
Read-only. Task subagent with grok-architect.md prompt.
Implements handoff in .grok/worktrees/<task_id>. Assert-EditScope before writes. Returns worker_summary JSON.
Read-only. code-reviewer subagent for integration pass. Satisfies final integration safety floor with claude-code.
Main Claude Code session. Human + Claude jointly act as Orchestrator. Does not appear as a delegated worker in handoffs.
Read-only. Invoked only for cross-cutting design. Produces ADR/proposal; Orchestrator/Planner convert to tasks. Never writes handoffs or code.
Read-only. Emits dependency DAG + per-task metadata. Output drives wave scheduling.
Read-only, highly parallelizable. Used for external knowledge or deep repo archaeology before planning/coding.

Primary implementation worker. Runs in isolated git worktree on task branch. Edits only declared file_ownership within coder_edit_roots. Returns structured summary + changed files. Never writes global state.

Read-only verification roles. Modes: task-branch audit, candidate integration (authoritative), docs review. Final integration Critic MUST run on a runtime satisfying can_run_tests + repo_read (claude-code qualifies).
Serial only. Updates docs/ after integration verified and docs_impact:true. Never runs in parallel. Never touches source/tests. Batch overlapping docs tasks.
Example local-script usage: execute build/test scripts or simple repo queries that return stdout. Output normalized before use. Cannot satisfy edit_code or final Critic safety floors.

notes: Claude-only profile: runtime 'claude-code' + enabled:true. Grok profile: runtime 'grok-cursor' + enabled:true. Both share protocol/state/branches; coordinate via orchestrator.lock. Async runtime extension: see _EXTENSION_CONTRACT.md.
